name: 真实回归门禁验证
description: 由真实 Drools 测试套件通过后创建

steps.name: 年轻客户额度规则
steps.drl:
package workbench

// 与业务系统交换的事实类型；输入字段由调用方设置，动作写回输出字段。
declare RuleInput
    customerAge : Integer
    annualIncome : Double
    creditScore : Integer
    customerType : String
    overdue : Boolean
    riskLevel : String
    reviewRequired : Boolean
    approvedLimit : Double
end

rule "年轻客户额度规则 [1]"
    salience 10
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( customerAge < 30, annualIncome < 100000d )
then
    modify($input) {
        setApprovedLimit(50000d),
        setRiskLevel("中")
    }
end

suites.name: 真实 Drools 回归验证

name: 信用风控决策服务
description: 决策表评级后执行年轻客户额度规则

steps.name: 信用评级决策表（演示）
steps.drl:
package workbench

// 与业务系统交换的事实类型；输入字段由调用方设置，动作写回输出字段。
declare RuleInput
    customerAge : Integer
    annualIncome : Double
    creditScore : Integer
    customerType : String
    overdue : Boolean
    riskLevel : String
    reviewRequired : Boolean
    approvedLimit : Double
end

rule "信用评级决策表（演示） 第1行 [1]"
    salience 0
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( creditScore >= 700, customerType in ("VIP", "whale") )
then
    modify($input) {
        setRiskLevel("低"),
        setReviewRequired(false)
    }
end

rule "信用评级决策表（演示） 第2行 [2]"
    salience 0
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( creditScore >= 500, creditScore <= 700, customerType == "normal" )
then
    modify($input) {
        setRiskLevel("中"),
        setReviewRequired(true)
    }
end

rule "信用评级决策表（演示） 第3行 [3]"
    salience 0
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( creditScore <= 500 )
then
    modify($input) {
        setRiskLevel("高"),
        setReviewRequired(true)
    }
end

rule "信用评级决策表（演示） 默认行 [4]"
    salience -1
    no-loop true
when
    not RuleInput( creditScore >= 700, customerType in ("VIP", "whale") )
    not RuleInput( creditScore >= 500, creditScore <= 700, customerType == "normal" )
    not RuleInput( creditScore <= 500 )
    $input : RuleInput(  )
then
    modify($input) {
        setRiskLevel("待定"),
        setReviewRequired(false)
    }
end
